build_vgg19_feature_extractor: build a VGG19 feature extractor that returns activations from 5 intermediate layers of a pretrained network
create_vgg19_frozen: create a VGG19 feature extractor with frozen parameters by setting requires_grad to False
build_vggloss_masked: build a masked VGG perceptual loss module that computes L1 distance between VGG feature maps of two images
create_vggloss_custom_weights: create a VGGLossMasked instance with custom per-layer weights for weighted perceptual loss computation
run_vgg_normalize: run image normalization using ImageNet mean and std values on RGB tensors scaled to 0-255
